**Finding submitted: TRANSITION — missing (confidence 0.86)**

The agreement is a hosting arrangement in which HDI stores and operates the Site and holds our Content, user information and data, but its termination provisions (Sections 4.1–4.2) deal only with notice and the Termination Payment. I confirmed by full-section review and targeted searches (transition, return, export, delete, expiration, machine-readable, migration) that no exit, data-return or deletion mechanic exists anywhere — the survival clause (10.7) and confidentiality provisions (8.1–8.3) do not supply one. That fails both the preferred and fallback checklists.

Redline (validated, ok:true): a new Section 4.3 inserted after Section 4.2(c), drafted at the preferred level in a single operation covering all six elements — up to six months' transition assistance at HDI's then-current rates, return of Company Data (Content, customer lists and other data belonging to, supplied by or processed for us) in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days of expiry or termination, and certified deletion after that return. The comment offers the 90-day/30-day export fallback as a negotiating position.
